window.heroAssert=(value,message)=>{if(!value)throw new Error(message);return message}; window.heroStats=()=>{const s=sandingLab.scene.getStats();if(s.robot?.jointErrors)heroAssert(Object.values(s.robot.jointErrors).every(v=>Number.isFinite(v)&&v<.003),'rigid arm lengths are preserved through motion');return s;}; window.heroPose=()=>{const s=heroStats();return JSON.stringify({tool:s.toolPosition,robot:s.robot,pose:s.lastPose})}; window.heroCamera=()=>JSON.stringify(heroStats().camera); const s=heroStats(); heroAssert(s.webgl,'Hero renderer uses WebGL'); heroAssert(s.meshCount>=60,'physical scene contains robot, tooling and environment'); heroAssert(document.querySelectorAll('#heroViewport canvas').length===1,'one persistent WebGL canvas'); heroAssert(!!document.querySelector('#demoToggle')&&!!document.querySelector('#explodeTool'),'motion and tool controls are available'); sandingLab.scene.setDemo(false); sandingLab.scene.setView('overview'); s

heroAssert(heroCamera()!==heroCameraBefore,'pointer drag changes camera'); heroAssert(sandingLab.state.tab===heroTabBefore,'drag preserves lesson'); window.heroCameraBefore=heroCamera(); 'pointer orbit passed'
heroAssert(heroCamera()!==heroCameraBefore,'keyboard changes camera'); heroAssert(sandingLab.state.tab===heroTabBefore,'canvas keyboard does not change lesson'); 'keyboard orbit passed'

heroAssert(heroPose()!==heroPoseBefore,'demonstration changes actual robot or tool pose'); heroAssert(heroStats().frameCount>heroFrameBefore,'demonstration renders new frames'); sandingLab.scene.setDemo(false); heroStats()
heroAssert(heroStats().frameCount-heroIdleFrames<=3,'paused scene does not render continuously'); heroStats()

const h=heroStats().hose;if(h?.end&&h?.extractorPort){const v=p=>Array.isArray(p)?p:[p.x,p.y,p.z],distance=Math.hypot(...v(h.end).map((n,i)=>n-v(h.extractorPort)[i]));heroAssert(h.connected===false&&distance>.1,'disconnected hose shows a physical gap at the extractor');({gap:distance,expectedGap:h.intendedServiceGap});}else 'hose gap statistics unavailable'

heroAssert(document.body.dataset.theme==='dark','dark theme switches'); const h=heroStats().hose; window.heroHoseCoverage='not exposed'; if(h?.start&&h?.end&&h?.toolPort&&h?.extractorPort){const v=p=>Array.isArray(p)?p:[p.x,p.y,p.z],dist=(a,b)=>Math.hypot(...v(a).map((n,i)=>n-v(b)[i])); const direct=Math.max(dist(h.start,h.toolPort),dist(h.end,h.extractorPort)),reverse=Math.max(dist(h.end,h.toolPort),dist(h.start,h.extractorPort)); heroAssert(Math.min(direct,reverse)<0.015,'hose endpoints meet physical ports'); window.heroHoseCoverage='verified';} ({stats:heroStats(),hoseCoverage:heroHoseCoverage})
